# `mise tasks graph`

- **Usage:** `mise tasks graph [FLAGS]`
- **Effect:** read-only
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/tasks/graph.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/tasks/graph.rs)

[experimental] Show the monorepo project graph

Lists the projects mise infers from Cargo, uv, Go, and Node.js workspace manifests, with each project's ID, root directory, dependencies, and metadata. `mise run --affected` uses this graph to decide which projects a change touches. Requires `experimental = true`.

See <https://mise.jdx.dev/tasks/workspace-graph.html>

## Flags
- **`-J --json`** — Output the project graph as JSON
- **`--explain`** — Show which provider and workspace file each project, dependency, and task field came from
- **`--no-header`** — Do not print table headers
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

List projects and their dependencies

```
mise tasks graph
```

Print the project graph as JSON

```
mise tasks graph --json
```

Show which workspace file each project, dependency, and task came from

```
mise tasks graph --explain
```
